title: Spectral Profile Nonuniqueness at a Common Stationary Vacuum
editorial_changes: Clarified that the additional nodes are fixed while small positive weights are introduced.
Clarified that both restricted curvatures are positive, but their values are unequal in the numerical example.
Specified nonzero kernel vectors and the augmented nonsingularity condition.
Made explicit that the pair may depend on p and that p+8 is sufficient without a minimality claim.
Preserved the distinction between exact internal sums and the inherited low-external-derivative expansion.
Retained the alternative open route of proving insensitivity of the completed electromagnetic observable.
Described the independence statement as a linear combination of the Laurent monomials and the remaining kernels.
Called the predecessor examples five- and six-component profiles, rather than five- and six-profile examples.
